subject: Can we move our onboarding call?
text:
Hi team,

Something came up on our side — could we push tomorrow's onboarding call to later in the week? Thursday afternoon would work great for us.

Thanks!
Mia

subject: Re: Can we move our onboarding call?
text:
Quick follow-up: Friday morning also works if Thursday is too tight. Whatever is easiest for you.

Mia

subject: Invoice #2041 shows our old billing address
text:
Hello,

We moved offices last month and invoice #2041 still shows the old billing address. Could you re-issue it with the address below?

Acme Corp
42 Harbor Way, Suite 300
Rotterdam

Best,
Ben

subject: Password reset link expired
text:
Hi,

I requested a password reset but the link had already expired by the time I opened it. Could you send a fresh one to this address?

Thanks,
Priya

subject: Feature request: CSV export for reports
text:
Hey there,

Loving the product so far. One thing that would help our finance team a lot: a CSV export on the monthly reports page. Is that on the roadmap?

Cheers,
Leo

subject: Security questionnaire before we sign
text:
Hello,

Our IT team has a short security questionnaire that needs answering before we can sign the order form. The main questions are about data residency, backups and who on your side can access our mailboxes.

Could you send it back by Friday?

Best,
Elena Brooks
IT Lead, Northwind

subject: Pricing for the 40-seat plan
text:
Hi Dev,

Thanks for the demo last week. Before I take this to our CFO: what would the 40-seat plan cost on an annual contract, and is there any room on the price if we commit for two years?

Best,
Sam Patel
Head of Operations, Northwind

subject: Re: Pricing for the 40-seat plan
text:
One more thing: our finance team asked whether you can invoice quarterly instead of annually. That would make the approval a lot easier.

Sam

subject: Rollout plan for the Berlin office
text:
Hi Dev,

We'd like to roll Owlat out to our Berlin office next month, about 25 people. Could we set up a short call to go through the migration from our current mail provider?

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Acme Corp

subject: Your talk at the meetup
text:
Hey,

Really enjoyed your talk at the meetup on Tuesday. Would you share the slides? A few people at my table asked for them too.

Cheers,
Alex

subject: Renewal terms for next year
text:
Hi Taylor,

Our current contract runs out at the end of the quarter. Before we renew, could you send me the terms for next year, including the support hours?

Kind regards,
Omar Haddad
Procurement, Northwind
